bio.text: Jeremy Moss, a state senator from Bloomfield, won the Democratic nomination for Michigan's open 11th Congressional District in the August 4, 2026 primary and faces Republican Ethan Baker in November.
According to his Michigan Senate biography, he was elected to the Southfield City Council in 2011, later served in the Michigan House of Representatives, and then joined the Michigan Senate.
He earned a bachelor's degree in journalism from Michigan State University and lives in Bloomfield Township.

sources.title: Moss secures Democratic nomination in Michigan's 11th Congressional District
